data.description: Experience Unmatched Luxury in Every Detail
data.display_address: Cavalli Casa Tower, Al Sufouh 2, Al Sufouh, Dubai
data.long_description:
Step into a world of elevated luxury at Cavalli Tower, the first-ever Cavalli-branded residential tower globally, located in the heart of Dubai Marina. This 70-storey masterpiece, designed by the acclaimed architect Shaun Killa, features an exquisite collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with uninterrupted views of Palm Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab, and the sparkling Dubai skyline. Positioned in the elite Al Sufouh area, the tower offers effortless access to key destinations while surrounding residents with elegance, exclusivity, and coastal charm.

Every detail in Cavalli Tower is curated for the ultimate lifestyle—from six panoramic jet elevators offering sea-facing rides to a private beach pool with pop-up F&B service. Enjoy fine dining on the 58th floor by world-renowned chefs or unwind in the serene sky gardens overlooking the city. With luxurious finishes, dynamic architecture, and breathtaking water features throughout, Cavalli Tower is more than a residence—it's a statement of bold, designer living in one of Dubai’s most iconic waterfront locations.
